name: supabase-mcp
description: Supabase (builder tools): list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_item. Every tool ma

platform_mcp_supabase_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_supabase_secret_key.description: Project secret key (sb_secret_…, Project Settings > API Keys), sent in the apikey header as Supabase documents for publishable/secret keys. It bypasses Row Level Security: keep it server-side.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /rest/v1/{table}?select=*&limit&offset: rows of the table named by collection (required). Each row is in raw; id/title/updated_at are read from columns of those names when present. query is not sent (PostgREST filters are column-specific).

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /rest/v1/{table}?id=eq.{item_id}&select=*: the row whose id column equals item_id (the table needs an `id` column).

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: POST /rest/v1/{table} [fields] with Prefer: return=representation: inserts one row whose columns are the keys of fields; title/content are not columns and are not sent.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Upsert: POST /rest/v1/{table} [{id: item_id, …fields}] with Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates: updates the given columns of the row whose primary key `id` equals item_id (inserts it when missing).

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: DELETE /rest/v1/{table}?id=eq.{item_id}: deletes the row(s) whose id equals item_id.
